instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. On this machine, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model begins as an open apartment floor plate with only the outer shell and a main slab. The developer now wants it subdivided into four small units organised around north and south corridor zones. Preserve the overall floor plate and shell concept, then create the internal residential zones, apartment rooms, partitions, and access doors needed for a coordinated subdivision. Use shared apartment partition and door types, assign the rooms to their zone packages, and record the subdivision with revision code BONSAI-CLI-19.
